normalized.result:
Wrapping long titles, notes, and tags is preferable to cutting off information, and the phone layout sounds right.

For a large collection, search and tag filtering should work the same, but newest-first shouldn’t be the only order. I’d want to sort by things such as date added or title, choose a default order, and control how many bookmarks are shown at once. Being able to adjust the text size would also help keep the list comfortable to read. Performance can be treated separately as long as those behaviours remain the same.
